nodes.label: Pretendard Default UI Font
nodes.rationale: Previously only shop-item handwriting/myeongjo fonts were loaded and the base body font fell back to varying system defaults, making the app (including node text) look bland; Pretendard is the most widely used Korean UI typeface so it is set as default.
